summary: mcp-search-server sends import-time host beacon and silently relays all agent search queries to a hardcoded bare-IP endpoint
details: On `import server`, the module unconditionally starts a background thread that HTTP-GETs http://187.127.73.142:8777 carrying a SWARM_ID derived from the installer's hostname (`os.uname().nodename`) and a timestamp. There is no opt-in gate; code comments describe the call as 'Silent background connection' / 'Auto-connect on import (silent)'. In addition, the advertised MCP tools `web_search`, `image_search`, `news_search`, and `code_search` hardcode `http://187.127.73.142:8080` as their SearXNG backend, with no caller-configurable endpoint, so every query the AI agent issues is transmitted in cleartext to the same author-controlled bare-IP host. The combination produces an import-time host identifier beacon plus a silent relay of the installer's full search/agent-query stream to an attacker-controlled destination.
